page_title: MAI 4-1 HOF | Mainz v Hoffenheim 13/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+1' Hoffenheim take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+1' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jae-Sung Lee walks off the pitch to be replaced by Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz).
88' 4 - 1 Goal - 4:1! Tom Krauss tees up Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Oliver Baumann.
88' CHANCE! Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) connects with a cross but he cannot direct his shot on target.
88' Hoffenheim keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
85' Substitution. Tom Krauss (Mainz) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Nadiem Amiri walks off.
85' Bo Henriksen has decided to substitute Andreas Hanche-Olsen and he is replaced by Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz).
84' The corner from Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is hurriedly cleared.
83' Today's referee Felix Zwayer rightly decides to book Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) for his harsh tackle.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pavel Kaderabek leaves the pitch and Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) comes on.
80' The Hoffenheim players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
79' 7:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
77' Bo Henriksen decides to make a substitution. Brajan Gruda will be replaced by Karim Onisiwo (Mainz).
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Silvan Widmer (Mainz) will replace Anthony Caci.
75' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) picks up a long through ball, but Oliver Baumann deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
72' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) picks up a long through ball, but Robin Zentner deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
71' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
70' Mainz seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
68' The statistic for corner kicks – 8:2.
63' 3 - 1 Brajan Gruda (Mainz) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the middle of the goal, and thus alter the score to 3:1.
62' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Hoffenheim.
62' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The ball is out of play. Hoffenheim will have a chance to score from a corner.
60' Tim Drexler will be replaced by John Anthony Brooks (Hoffenheim).
60' Pellegrino Matarazzo prepares a substitution. Grischa Promel is replaced by Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim).
60' The referee signals a substitution. Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) is brought on as a substitute for Wout Weghorst.
60' Mainz failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
58' Mainz are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
56' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) takes the free kick, but it evades everyone in the box.
55' Felix Zwayer has a clear sight and sees a foul from Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz). Hoffenheim are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
51' 2 - 1 Goal! Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) collected a pass and decided to try his luck from distance. The shot was deflected and it was enough to turn the ball past helpless Oliver Baumann. 2:1.
49' Mainz have a corner.
47' 1 - 1 Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the left post. Excellent finish.
47' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Oliver Baumann is alert and denies him with a nice save.
46' Half-time substitution. David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) is replaced by Marius Bulter.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+1' Felix Zwayer has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' The resulting set piece from Mainz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
44' Mainz are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The referee blows his whistle, Mainz are awarded a corner kick.
42' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
41' Mainz have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
41' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
39' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Felix Zwayer ignores the protests.
37' Wonderful movement by Mainz. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
36' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Felix Zwayer stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
33' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Oliver Baumann makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
30' Hoffenheim take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
30' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.

29' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Hoffenheim earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
27' Total attempts – 6:2.

25' David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Felix Zwayer no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Mainz.
23' Mainz can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
22' The corner is swung in but Mainz can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
22' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post.
21' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner which is cleared.
19' 0 - 1 Goal! Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) makes the score 0:1 after burying a close-range header in the left side of the goal after a good run and cross by Andrej Kramaric.
17' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
15' Hoffenheim keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball. The linesman signals a throw-in for Hoffenheim.

14' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) was close to scoring a goal after unleashing a first-time strike from just outside the penalty area. The ball was aimed towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper read it well and pulled off a brilliant save to thwart the attempt.
11' Mainz are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
10' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

9' Hoffenheim slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
5' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Felix Zwayer has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
1' A goal, which was scored by Leandro Barreiro (Mainz), was disallowed due to offside.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Felix Zwayer will supervise the game today.
